messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: Paging delivery failure: 3 downstream connectors failed to ACK fanout for alert id=abc123. Retrying with backoff, will escalate if not recovered in 5m.

sre-oncall: seeing it, looking.

alex: any customer impact?

incidentbot: affected routes: sms-relay, gcal-notifier, pagerflow. duplicate suppressor engaged after partial retries. logs: ```ERROR fanout: 502 from sms-relay; ack_timeout on pagerflow; duplicate_filter: emitted=1 suppressed=3``` 

maria: I can confirm several customers reported no page. @sre-oncall have you kicked a manual retry?

sre-oncall: doing manual fanout for critical oncall groups now. running script: ```/ops/fanout_retry --alert abc123 --targets=all --force``` 

jordan: FYI automation chan muted the incident-channel for 30s because of rapid failures, that's why some oncall didn't see initial notification.

ops: that mute came from the suppressor after threshold breach, looks like it suppressed subsequent pages. disabling suppressor now.

maria: customer impact: 2 PagerDuty incidents not created, customers A123 & B789 reached out.

alex: note for postmortem: suppressor threshold too low for probe spikes. Can we add an emergency bypass for critical severity?

sre-oncall: re-enabled pages, manual fanout completed, both customers paged. monitoring.

incidentbot: manual fanout results: success for targets=all. summary: sms 0/200 failed -> 200/200, pagerflow acked, gcal retried. will leave automation disabled for 10m.

alex: can someone capture logs and create incident ticket? I'll start a retro.

jordan: filing INC-2026-089 in Jira, attaching logs.

maria: reminder: update on-call playbook to mention how to force bypass and when to disable suppressor.

sre-oncall: leaving note here, will follow up with timeline and metrics. :thumbsup:
